reviews.t: Best to soothe and protect dry cracked hands.
reviews.x: I have very dry skin with some eczema.  This is the first lotion I have found that soothes and protects without making my hands too greasy. I have tried many different kinds.  I am on the computer 12 hours a day so I don't want to grease up my keyboard with greasy lotions. I keep this handy on my office desk as well as my home desk. This is possibly the BEST hand cream out there. You can wash your hands and it stays on..at least one time. It is not greasy. It is light. I have old, dry skin, and it really helps...
We live in Phoenix. I put one of these by every sink, one in my nightstand and one in the living room. It keeps my hands soft and prevents me from picking at my nails.

Excellent. Doesn't leave your hands feeling greasy.  Great for use on those dry winter hands.

I use this lotion as often as I can during the work day and it provides the best moisture to my hands and the continuous washing. It has helped moisturize between my fingers, and at my thumb folds where I have cracked with dry skin. It 100% works better than all other lotions I have tried. I wish it came in an economy pump bottle, but I keep a tube of this with me at work all the time, and have let others use it as well.
Love this lotion. My hands are always in water and this product is so worth it.

This lotion is pretty good. I gave it 3 stars because it has a tendency to clump, flake and dry on my hand hair. reviews.t: The best out there. Look no further.
reviews.x: This has been my favorite hand moisturizer for years. I had a complete panic attack when I thought Avon was discontinuing this product. Luckily it appears they didn't. I put bottles of Silicone Glove in every possible place I spend time: work, bedside, bathroom, car, bag, purse, etc. There's practically no smell. No oily residue. The result is a wonderful, silky feeling that lasts for hours. I cannot recommend this lotion enough.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lotion for moisturizing dry, cracked hands without leaving a greasy residue.
Many reviewers, especially nurses and people who wash their hands often, say it protects hands from dryness and cracking.
Several reviewers keep multiple tubes on hand and consider it a favorite or repeat purchase.
A few reviewers complain about a strong floral scent.
One reviewer notes the lotion can clump, flake, and not last very long.
